integrity: Proof reconstructed using exact conditional increments, moment recurrences, and bounded martingale convergence; finite enumeration and recurrence verification run from accompanying standard-library checker. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
limitations: Only scalar edge density for fixed r and full neighborhood inheritance from a singleton seed; the full limiting law, rates, and intermediate copying probabilities remain untreated. Some older twin-insertion sources could require further historical-priority comparison.
title: Non-self-averaging edge density at the full-duplication endpoint
